text.s2: Friday afternoon. Tokens to spare. Terminals… forgotten.
text.s3: So the human releases… the minions.
text.s4: No manager. No stand-up. They simply… talk.
text.s5: The fox claims the login bug. The cat, wisely… backs away.
text.s6: Nobody asked for a hierarchy. Nobody ever does.
text.s7: They display their work. The human scrolls… occasionally nodding.
text.s8: And when stuck… it asks. Rarely seen in the wild.
